messages:
nina: We need a small, low-risk base-image rebuild to remove setuid helpers and trim xz-utils. Target window: Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC. Want least-priv RBAC and signing flow validation.

leo: Proposal: use a delegated cosign subkey (short-lived) authorized by offline master. That lets us revoke the subkey if needed without touching master.

sec-oncall: Please ensure the bake pipeline emits structured audit JSON with fields: actor, action=bake, image_sha, key_id, audit_trace_id, and forwards to audit tenant.

nina: Will add pre-hook that writes one JSON line per bake. Sample: echo '{"actor":"$USER","action":"bake","image":"'$IMAGE'","key":"'$KEY'","trace":"'$TRACE'"}' >> /var/log/image-audit.log

tara: I'll scope the image-baker SA to only storage.objects.create and iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob. No cluster-admin. Draft RBAC YAML incoming.

leo: Add a post-bake smoke: run container, GET /health, assert p90 < 250ms. If fail -> auto revert routing.

deploy-bot: bake job scheduled: jb-9901 for 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z. Alerts to #eng-runtime and #eng-oncall.

sec-oncall: Also keep previous signed image as canary tag and plan 5% canary for 30m before full cutover. Add cosign revocation steps to runbook.

nina: Checklist: RBAC PR merged 48h prior, audit hook in staging, KMS/cosign test, smoke tests green, rollback doc published. Reconvene Mon 15:00 UTC.

leo: PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4402 (rbac).

tera: pushed hook to staging branch
https://git.internal/repo/ops/hooks/commit/cd34. Smoke job linked to jb-9901.

sec-oncall: I'll prepare a short evidence-collection playbook in case of incident.
